user.title: Connect CDC USB Terminal
user.description: Select the serial port the GCBASIC CDC/USB board (VID:PID 1209:2008) is connected on.

data_description.scan_interval: How often, in seconds, the device is polled automatically while the 'Data Logging' switch is on. When that switch is off, polling on this interval is skipped (no commands sent) until it's turned back on; manual buttons and LED toggles still work either way. Adjustable later without re-adding the device via the 'Logging Period' entity.

confirm.title: CDC USB device discovered
confirm.description: A CDC USB Terminal device was found on {port}. Add it to Home Assistant?

error.cannot_connect: Could not open the serial port or the device did not respond to the probe.

data_description.scan_interval: How often, in seconds, the device is polled automatically while the 'Data Logging' switch is on. This is the same value as the 'Logging Period' entity - changing it here or there updates the other.
